'''A-Foroon''' was a windy [[Planet/Legends|world]] of scraggly [[Forest/Legends|forests]] located in the [[A-Foroon system/Legends|A-Foroon system]], a part of the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was situated on the [[Triellus Trade Route/Legends|Triellus Trade Route]] [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|hyperlane]], which linked it to the [[B-Foroon system/Legends|B-Foroon]] and [[Piroket system/Legends|Piroket systems]].<ref name="TEA" />

A-Foroon, [[B-Foroon]], and [[C-Foroon]] together constituted the [[Foroon Worlds]], which were remade by members of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]] into [[Throneworld/Legends|throneworlds]] during the [[Standard century/Legends|century]] immediately preceding the [[Declaration of a New Order|dissolution]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. A-Foroon was specifically controlled by the the Hutt [[Jahibakti]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]], in the name of which gangs of the [[Yahk-Tosh]] [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] operated on the throneworld.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
A-Foroon was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square R-16.<ref name="TEA" />
